clips.send: Fragments and run-ons. The two most common sentence errors. Fragment: missing a subject or verb, or just a dependent clause. Fix: attach it to a sentence. Run-on (fused): “The bus was late we missed the bell.” Comma splice: “The bus was late, we missed the bell.”. Fix a run-on 4 ways: period, semicolon, comma + FANBOYS, or make one clause dependent. Fragment equals too little. Run-on equals too much, no glue. Long is not equal to run-on. A long sentence that’s properly joined is fine.

clips.send: Phrase vs. clause. A clause has a subject AND a verb; a phrase doesn’t. Phrase: “after the game”, “my little brother”: no subject + verb pair. Clause: “my brother cheered”: subject (brother) + verb (cheered). Independent clause: makes sense alone. Dependent clause: starts with a word like because, when, although, if, until and needs an independent clause. Clause equals who + does what. “Because I was tired.” has a subject and verb but is still a fragment: “because” makes it dependent.

clips.send: 短语与分句。分句有主语和谓语，短语没有。短语，phrase：“after the game”“my little brother”，没有“主语 + 谓语”的组合。分句，clause：“my brother cheered”，有主语（brother）和谓语（cheered）。独立分句能单独成句；从属分句以 because、when、although、if、until 等词开头，必须依附一个独立分句。中文常叫它“从句”。分句 等于 谁 + 做什么。“Because I was tired.”有主语有谓语，但仍是残缺句：because 让它变成了从句。

clips.send: 复合句（主从复合句）。一个独立分句 + 至少一个从句。从句在前，加逗号：“When the lights flickered, Dad grabbed a flashlight.”。从句在后，通常不加逗号：“Dad grabbed a flashlight when the lights flickered.”。从属连词：because, when, although, if, since, until, while, after, before（引导状语从句）。记住常见从属连词：as, although, after, while, when, unless, because, before, if, since。英语里 complex 是指“含有从句”，不是指“难懂”。
